name: claude-atlas
description: Source-cited Obsidian knowledge bases for Claude Code, and projects that live in your work: an inbox to ingest from, one reviewed operation per change, git history in every knowledge base, and threads in an atlas/ folder beside your code: each line of work moves from stub to spec to plan to receipt, one visible document per stage. Skills for ingesting, querying, linting, describing projects, threads, canvases, and Bases. Pairs with the claude-atlas binary, which serves the tools.
